summary: A five-day Chengdu trip based near Luomashi, a short walk from Chunxi Road. It has a hotpot dinner on arrival, Kuanzhai Alleys in the old quarter, a day trip to Dujiangyan and Qingcheng Shan, and a relaxed last morning before the airport. Several of your named places (Taikoo Li, the Panda Base, Wuhou Shrine, Jinli, Du Fu Thatched Cottage) could not be scheduled, so days 1, 3 and 5 are lighter than you asked for.
